brief.headline: Push for a ₹0.65–0.80/pc target on caps (vs market typical ₹0.85–0.95) and tighten payment to 15 days to free ₹2.60 L cash, backed by five qualified alternates.

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc on 28 mm caps at higher volume or relaxed specs.
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for this cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, with typical deals at ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The market verdict says there's modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec—so we push for that lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Tightening payment by 15 days frees ₹2.60 L in cash for us.

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, cash position or debt. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend is meaningful to a private converter, but without their numbers we can't judge how hard to squeeze. The plan leans on our own price intelligence, the open market band, and the five solid alternates we've lined up. We lead with price and payment discipline, not financial pressure, and use the backup list to show we're serious about a second source.

evidence.point: We spend ₹63.21 L a year with them—a material book of business for a private packaging converter.
Market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, with typical deals landing at ₹0.85–0.95/pc.
The market verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec.
We currently pay 30 days after receipt; tightening to 15 days frees ₹2.60 L in cash for us.
HDPE resin import unit value sits at 87.61 ₹/kg, giving us a raw-material cost floor to reference.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter—pharma bottles, caps, preforms—with strong health (B, 65/100) and ₹2569.83 Cr revenue. Top second-source candidate.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma); strong and profitable—a robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd
alternates.why: Listed PET bottle/jar specialist (Pearlpet)—direct fit for PET bottles if we need to broaden the base.

risks: Bprex's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their cash and profit cushion—stick to price/payment discipline and don't overreach without visibility.
The market-ask data is a reference band (public asking prices, not audited quotes)—confirm our actual purchase history and get competing quotes before locking the ₹0.65–0.80 target.
Five alternates (three listed, two private) are lined up, but none are qualified yet—kick off RFQs now so we have real backup quotes before the next renewal.
Tightening payment by 15 days saves us ₹2.60 L but may pinch a smaller private supplier—watch for pushback and be ready to trade payment speed for a steeper price cut.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹63.21 L a year on rigid packaging with you, and the market shows caps landing at ₹0.85–0.95 with room to ₹0.65–0.80 at scale—let's talk about hitting that lower band and moving to 15-day payment to free cash for both of us.
